summary_en: 5,602,700 shares (32.32% S/O) of Genova Inc. transferred from founder/CEO Toshiki Hirase to Hirase Shoten (his asset management company) on June 11–12, 2026. Hirase Shoten's stake increases from 7.69% to 40.00%, becoming largest shareholder. Transfer qualifies as a regulatory acquisition act under FIEA Article 167(1). Founder retains executive role.
title_en: Notice of Changes in Major Shareholder and Lead Major Shareholder (Planned) and Acquisition Act Equivalent to Public Tender Offer as Prescribed by Ordinance
translation_en_brief: On June 11–12, 2026, founder and CEO Toshiki Hirase will transfer his entire holding of 5,602,700 shares (32.32% of outstanding shares ex-treasury) to Hirase Shoten, his asset management company. The transfer occurs in two tranches: 1,830,000 shares on June 11 and 3,772,700 shares on June 12. Following the first tranche, Hirase Shoten's voting stake will exceed 10% and qualify as a major shareholder; after the second tranche, Hirase Shoten will hold 6,935,900 shares (40.00% S/O), becoming the largest shareholder, while Hirase himself ceases to be a major shareholder. The acquisition qualifies as a regulatory acquisition act (買集め行為) under FIEA Article 167(1) and Ordinance Article 31 because it involves a 5%+ acquisition by voting rights. Hirase Shoten is a domestic asset management and real estate services company with 1 million yen capital. The filing notes that Hirase retains his position as representative director and CEO.
